name: NCES Public School Universe Official PTR
population: Public elementary and secondary schools in CCD universe
numerator_definition: Total student membership headcount across all grades offered (PreK-12)
notes: Authoritative NCES CCD school-level operationalization. Does not deduct Pre-K; denominator is FTE classroom teachers as reported by states.

name: NCES LEA Non-Fiscal Survey Official PTR
denominator_definition: Total LEA teacher FTE (including itinerant and centralized teachers)
notes: Authoritative NCES CCD LEA-level operationalization. Includes itinerant and centrally assigned instructional staff not assigned to building codes.

name: Observatory K-12 Adjusted PTR
population: Regular public elementary and secondary schools with Pre-K isolated
numerator_definition: K-12 student membership (MEMBER minus PK enrollment)
denominator_definition: K-12 teacher FTE (Total teacher FTE minus reported Pre-K teacher FTE)
notes: Observatory-derived implementation from KC Education Capacity Study. Explicitly separates Pre-K from K-12 to isolate elementary and secondary instructional load.

name: Kansas State Classroom Teacher Ratio
denominator_definition: Full-time equivalent General and Subject Classroom Teachers (excluding specialists)
notes: State administrative operationalization from KSDE KPTEN/CPFS. Explicitly isolates general classroom teachers from SPED/reading specialists.

name: Kansas State Total Licensed Instructional Staff Ratio
denominator_definition: Total certified instructional personnel FTE (classroom teachers + specialists)
notes: State administrative operationalization from KSDE. Reflects total instructional staffing density.

name: NCES Public School Universe Fall Membership
population: Public elementary and secondary schools in CCD universe
numerator_definition: Unduplicated student headcount enrolled on the snapshot date across all grades offered (PreK-12)
notes: Official NCES school-level headcount membership. Includes Pre-K if offered. CTE/vocational centers without primary membership report 0.

name: NCES LEA Survey Fall Membership
numerator_definition: Unduplicated district student membership headcount under the official jurisdiction of the LEA
notes: Official NCES LEA-level membership. Includes centralized students, out-of-district day placements, and homebound students not attributed to a campus code. Exceeds sum of campus enrollments regionally by +0.74% (+2,445 students in KC metro).

name: Observatory K-12 Adjusted Headcount Membership
population: Regular public elementary and secondary schools / LEAs with Pre-K isolated
numerator_definition: K-12 student membership headcount (Total membership minus Pre-Kindergarten enrollment)
notes: Observatory-derived operationalization isolating mandatory schooling grades K-12 from non-compulsory Pre-K early childhood programs.

name: Missouri DESE Regular Average Daily Attendance (ADA)
population: Missouri public school districts and charter LEAs
reference_period_definition: Cumulative annual school year (total hours attended divided by calendar hours)
numerator_definition: Aggregate actual student attendance hours across the academic year divided by scheduled term hours
notes: Authoritative state funding operationalization under Missouri Foundation Formula. Typically 90-94% of fall headcount membership due to absenteeism.

name: Kansas State Department of Education Audited FTE Enrollment
numerator_definition: Audited full-time equivalent student count where kindergarten and part-time students are weighted by instructional time
notes: Kansas state funding formula operationalization. Prior to universal full-day kindergarten funding, Kindergarten counted as 0.5 FTE.
